Definitely going back
Dec 2025 • Couples
We waited about 10 minutes to be seated. It was well worth the wait. The service was excellent, and the food was as well. I started with the hot apple juice and ginger. It was so good, I ordered a second cup. I then had the big breakfast (eggs, bacon, sausage, baked beans, sourdough toast, and kale salad with pickled vegetables). I asked them to leave off the tomato and mushrooms. The kale salad was the best I've ever had. My wife had a soy milk latte, avocado on toast, baked beans, and a pink guava and pineapple juice. While we both loved our selections, my wife stated the avocado toast was the best she's ever had...and she's had a LOT of avocado toast. We will return!

A lovely spot in the Old Quarter for brunch style food…
Jul 2025 • Solo
I went to Salt and Pepper at the recommendation of the hotel I was staying at in the Old Quarter after telling the manager I was craving brunch.

 I walked in without a booking on a Sunday around 11:15am and was fortunate to be seated straight away. I ordered the pancakes with season fruits and a mango and passion fruit smoothie. Food arrived within a few minutes and the smoothie took slightly longer. Both were presented very invitingly, were delicious and definitely weep hit the spot. Staff attentive and friendly. It was busy when I was there but not overcrowded but certainly looked like a popular spot for brunch. 

They had a varied menu including pasta and fish dishes and when I spied them on other tables, they looked tasty. 

Recommend and would visit again if ever in Hanoi. 

Ps The hotel I was staying is L’Signature, Old Quarter, Hanoi. Also highly recommended.
